description: Retrieve the advancement points each team earned at an event, using whichever system the event belongs to: district points for district events, or FIRST Championship regional pool points for 2025+ regionals. Returns per-team qualification, alliance selection, elimination, award, and (for regionals) rookie bonus points with totals, plus tiebreakers (highest match scores, qualification wins). Returns null for events that award neither, such as off-season events.

event_key.description: TBA event key combining the season year and event code (e.g., '2023casj' for the 2023 Silicon Valley Regional, '2024txhou' for the 2024 Houston Championship, '2024micmp4' for a Michigan State Championship division). Use get_events or get_events_keys to discover valid event keys for a year.

name: get_event_advancement_points
title: Get Event Advancement Points
